recipe.visualDefinition: A modular 5x5 grid composition featuring repetitive, high-contrast close-up portraits of a single subject, each cell treated with distinct, vibrant color filters and varying crops to create a rhythmic, kaleidoscopic effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of a single face across a rigid geometric grid
Vibrant, saturated color shifts between adjacent modules
Central top-aligned typographic block acting as a focal anchor
coreInvariants: Uniform subject matter (same person in every cell)
Saturated primary and secondary color overlays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is repeated at varying scales, from extreme close-up eyes to full headshots, distributed across 25 grid cells.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-center grid cell containing the primary text block on a solid red background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A scanning motion across the grid, jumping between high-contrast highlights and deep shadows, eventually settling on the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows within the portraits provide the internal negative space, while the grid lines are implied by the edges of the color blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black shadows provide the structural foundation for all cells.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan, magenta, and yellow overlays create high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid red background in the text cell serves as the primary focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in highlights against absolute black values, typical of 1970s psychedelic soul aesthetics.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight with minimal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are compressed vertically to fit the blocky aesthetic

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a solid color block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with color-based hierarchy (black vs white text).
graphicDevices: Solid color block background for text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed block feel of 70s soul covers.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and authority.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 5x5 grid of high-contrast portraits of a man with glasses. Each cell should have a different color filter (cyan, magenta, lime, yellow, purple) over a black and white base image. The top-center cell must be a solid red square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, black and white sans-serif text centered in the red square. Use tight leading and uppercase letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within a single solid-colored cell?
Are the portraits high-contrast with deep black shadows?

postGenerationChecks: Check for color variety across adjacent cells
Ensure text is legible against the solid background
Verify that the subject's features are recognizable despite the filters
Confirm the ultra-bold weight of the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [Grid Size] grid of [Subject] portraits using [Color Palette] filters and high-contrast lighting, with a [Font Style] text block in the [Position] cell.
